description: This file defines structures, enums, and function prototypes for managing linkable loadable extensions (llext) in Zephyr OS, including ELF symbol handling, extension loading/unloading, and architecture-specific relocation functions.

methods.name: llext_by_name
methods.description: Finds an extension by its name.

methods.name: llext_iterate
methods.description: Iterates over registered extensions, calling a callback for each.

methods.name: llext_load
methods.description: Loads and links an extension from ELF data.

methods.name: llext_find_sym
methods.description: Finds the address of a symbol within an extension.

methods.name: llext_call_fn
methods.description: Calls a function within an extension by name.

methods.name: llext_add_domain
methods.description: Adds extension memory partitions to a memory domain.

methods.name: arch_elf_relocate
methods.description: Performs architecture-specific relocation of ELF opcodes.

methods.name: llext_find_section
methods.description: Finds an ELF section by name within loader data.

methods.name: arch_elf_relocate_local
methods.description: Updates addresses via relocation table for local symbols.
